description: This Java class, DatabaseDetective, is part of the OpenMRS project and provides functionality to check if the associated database is empty. It does so by connecting to the database, retrieving table metadata, and determining if only Liquibase changelog tables are present.

classes.name: DatabaseDetective
classes.description: Provides methods to detect whether the OpenMRS database is empty by examining the presence of tables other than Liquibase changelogs.

methods.name: isDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the database contains only Liquibase changelog tables or is empty, indicating it may be uninitialized.
